title: Beasley Media Group Celebrates Two Winners at the 2026 CMA Broadcast Awards
summary: NAPLES, Fla. — Oct. 13, 2026 — Beasley Media Group proudly announces that two of its country radio brands have earned top honors in the 2026 Country Music
body_markdown:
NAPLES, Fla. — Oct. 13, 2026 — Beasley Media Group proudly announces that two of its country radio brands have earned top honors in the


2026 Country Music Association (CMA) Broadcast Awards,


recognizing outstanding achievement in country radio broadcasting.


The awards celebrate the creativity, dedication and community connections that distinguish Beasley Media Group’s country radio personalities and stations across the country.


**Beasley Media Group’s 2026 CMA Broadcast Award winners are:**


**MAJOR MARKET BROADCAST PERSONALITY OF THE YEAR**


“The Andie Summers Show” — Andie Summers, Jeff Kurkjian, Donnie Black and Shannon Boyle, WXTU-FM, Philadelphia


**SMALL MARKET RADIO STATION OF THE YEAR**


WKML-FM — Fayetteville, North Carolina


“These awards are a tremendous honor and a powerful reflection of the extraordinary talent, passion and commitment our teams bring to country radio every single day,” said Justin Chase, Chief Content Officer of Beasley Media Group. “The Andie Summers Show and WKML represent the very best of what makes local radio so special. They entertain, inspire and build meaningful relationships with their listeners while making a real difference in the communities they serve. We’re incredibly proud of Andie, Jeff, Donnie, Shannon and the entire WKML team for earning this well-deserved national recognition. Their success is a testament to the creativity, authenticity and dedication that define Beasley Media Group.”


The recognition of The Andie Summers Show highlights the Philadelphia morning team’s ability to connect with audiences through compelling entertainment, engaging personalities and a genuine commitment to the community.


Meanwhile, WKML’s Small Market Radio Station of the Year honor celebrates the Fayetteville station’s continued dedication to delivering outstanding country music programming, serving its local audience and strengthening its connection to the community. This is WKML’s fifth year as a finalist and first win.


The CMA Broadcast Awards recognize excellence among radio personalities and stations throughout the United States and Canada. Winners are selected based on criteria that include on-air performance, community involvement, ratings, leadership and industry impact.


These two prestigious victories further underscore Beasley Media Group’s commitment to delivering exceptional local content, fostering meaningful audience relationships and supporting the continued growth of country radio.


The winners will be recognized during the CMA Awards Pre-Telecast Ceremony in Nashville.


“The 60th Annual CMA Awards”


will broadcast live from Bridgestone Arena in Nashville on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at 8 p.m. Eastern/7 p.m. Central on ABC and Disney+, with streaming available the following day on Hulu.
